Name: Mystic Rings
Author: besworks
Description:
[b][size=4]Usage :[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Select your preferred Combined Ring style in the config menu.
[*]Disable any individual ring texture that you don't want replaced.
[*]Enjoy your fancy new rings!
[/list][size=4]
[b]Update 2025-02-14 :[/b]

[size=3]Added [b]MANY[/b] new Combined Ring styles. There are now over 30 to choose from.[/size]

[b]Disclaimer :[/b][/size]

The colors of the output ring are determined by what rings you combine. The game picks this based on the Dye color of the ring. This mod does not affect that behavior.

Some of the smaller Combined Ring styles may bleed a few pixels through at the edges when combining some highly decorated rings (especially ones with auras). If this bothers you, try switching the order that you combine your rings, sometimes that's enough to avoid them. Either that or choose a larger style that will cover the input rings completely.

If you notice strange artifacts when using the combined ring styles with rings from other mods, check the alignment of the sprites. ALL RINGS [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2898]must align[/url] with the vanilla ring position for the combining feature to work properly. If the rings are offset or the wrong size you could end up with visual glitches. Choosing an opaque style that completely hides the combined ring should work fine with these.

[size=4][b]Compatibility Note : 

[/b][/size]The Combined Ring sprites in this pack do not affect the output of my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31791]Custom Combined Rings[/url]﻿, they replace the vanilla combined ring sprite and are specially formatted to work with the vanilla animation behavior. If you use these mods together, the combined ring style set in here will simply be a fallback if no other rules apply.
